description: Fix the cent-level money bugs in the storefront cart: float accumulation on subtotals (0.1 + 0.2 + 0.3 drift), per-unit discount rounding scaled by quantity, and parseFloat(toFixed(2)) totals after VAT; the hidden gate replays the finance reports and the integer-cents accessor contract.

criteria: cart.js computes every total in integer cents - unit prices converted once at add() time, lines summed as integers, discounts rounding the line total once, VAT rounding the final cent amount - and exposes subtotalCents, discountedSubtotalCents, totalCents and formatCents alongside the derived dollar-number methods, so the finance reports (0.6 drift, 27.14 line discount, 33.38 VAT total) come out exact without touching the gate or the README.
